trigger: The exact-gene representation audit retained aggregate efficacy for 8/8 organs but produced 0/8 full representation-gate passes.
primary_question: Is the expert signal reproducible in a shared, coarser continuous expression basis or within outcome-independent tissue sites nested under organ?

basis.source: GTEx training split expression only; no expert losses, calibration outcomes, or ARCHS4
basis.transform: log1p TPM, weighted mean and variance with equal total weight per donor
basis.sign_rule: the largest absolute loading in each component is positive
basis.module_definition: the 100 genes with largest absolute loading per component; overlap is allowed

attributes.secondary_strata: every organ/tissue_site cell with at least 30 calibration donors
attributes.selection_rule: eligibility uses manifest donor counts only, never efficacy or reproducibility

estimands.module_correction: donor-balanced specialist-minus-generic correction standardized by training-gene scale and projected onto the 32 frozen components
estimands.module_efficacy: donor-balanced specialist-vs-generic squared-error improvement averaged within each component's frozen top-100 gene module
estimands.semantic_control: donor-balanced random-K8 squared error minus named-specialist squared error
estimands.aggregation: samples are averaged within donor and stratum before equal donor weighting
estimands.seed_policy: all three seeds reported; no selection

decision_rule.coarse_program_success: at least 4 of 8 organs pass every module gate
decision_rule.hierarchical_site_signal: fewer than 4 organs pass, but at least 8 eligible sites spanning at least 3 multi-site organs pass
decision_rule.no_stable_existing_representation: otherwise stop mining the current organ experts and design factorized experts with explicit shared canonical program heads
decision_rule.forbidden_inference: module or site reproducibility alone does not prove that cross-organ training should be shared
